predecessors.name: Zimbabwe Rhodesia
predecessors.text: 'On 18 April 1980, Zimbabwe Rhodesia became the independent Republic of Zimbabwe within the Commonwealth of Nations' (Zimbabwe Rhodesia page); the Zimbabwe page has 'On 11 April 1980, Southern…

rulers.name: Robert Mugabe
rulers.title: head of government from 1980; executive president after the 1987 constitutional revision

wars.name: Second Congo War
wars.outcome: No territorial result for Zimbabwe: the page records only 'Zimbabwe's involvement from 1998 to 2002 in the war in the Democratic Republic of the Congo' and its cost to the economy.

wars.name: Gukurahundi (Matabeleland unrest)
wars.outcome: Internal campaign by the Fifth Brigade in Matabeleland, with no change of border; 'The campaign officially ended in 1987 after Nkomo and Mugabe reached a unity agreement'.

certainty.note: The Zimbabwe page records no border dispute or border change after independence; no page opened gives treaty text, so the level rests on that silence.
